tools.name: kdp_trim_sizes
tools.description: List every Amazon KDP paperback trim size (inches, mm, 300 DPI pixels, size with bleed, large-trim flag, maximum page count per paper/ink) and the minimum margins.

tools.name: kdp_cover_dimensions
tools.description: Full-wrap KDP paperback cover size (bleed included) and spine width from trim size, page count and paper, in inches, mm and 300 DPI pixels.

tools.name: kdp_royalty
tools.description: KDP paperback printing cost and royalty per sale from list price, page count, marketplace and ink, using KDP's published formulas and 50%/60% rates.

tools.name: kdp_margins
tools.description: Inside (gutter) and outside margins KDP requires for a paperback page count, plus the largest text area at a trim size.
